_readme: ARCHIVIST lines. One line is picked at random per event. {title}, {file}, {drawer}, {draft} are filled in automatically. Add as many as you like.
welcome: Ah. A visitor. Wipe your shoes, the carpet is classified.
Welcome to the archive. Touch nothing. Read everything.
Clearance confirmed. I checked. I didn't, but I said I did.
welcomeBack: You again. The drawers missed you. I did not.
Back so soon? Heuss rewrote three files while you were gone.
Returning visitor detected. Your usual seat is still uncomfortable.
night: Lights off. The files are more honest in the dark.
Night shift. Keep your voice down, the redactions are sleeping.
One lamp, one visitor, a thousand secrets. Cosy.
day: Daylight. The documents prefer it. They feel less guilty.

personnel: Personnel. Mind the names, some of them bite.
People drawer. Nobody here is who they said they were.
events: Events drawer. Every date in here was argued over.
programs: Programs. Budgets you will never see.
Programs. Listen. That beeping is perfectly normal.

TOP SECRET: {file}. Top secret. I'll pretend I didn't hand you that.
You are now reading {title}. Officially, you are not.
SECRET: {file}. Secret, but only mildly. Like a surprise party.
CONFIDENTIAL: {title}. Read it quietly, the walls are listening.
RESTRICTED: {file}. Restricted. Restricted to people who opened it, apparently.
Restricted file. Don't tell the restrictions.
DECLASSIFIED: {title}. Fully declassified. They checked twice. Badly.

draftEarly: Draft {draft}. Heuss would like that one back.
Careful. Draft {draft} still has opinions in it.
draftFinal: Draft 09. The version everyone agreed on. Not the one that happened.
Back to the final draft. Safe. Clean. Slightly untrue.
reveal: I'll put that back. You'll forget it. Deal?
Ink is temporary. Curiosity is forever.
searchEmpty: Nothing under that name. Either it never happened, or it worked.
No records found. That is either reassuring or alarming.
emptyDrawer: Empty drawer. Someone has been very thorough.
rush: Slow down. These are made of paper.
Please stop flicking. The folders have feelings.
idle: Still there? The dust is starting to settle on you.
Take your time. Nobody else is coming. Probably.
I'll just alphabetise something while you think.
soundOn: Sound on. If you hear numbers, write them down.
Audio restored. The radio in the corner is not ours.
soundOff: Silence. Exactly how the archive likes it.

enter: Mind the string. It's holding more together than the budget is.
The link room. Everything here is connected, whether it likes it or not.
Red string. The archive's only reliable filing system.
popular: {file}. Popular. That's rarely good for a file.
{title} knows a lot of people. Suspicious.
alone: {file}. No connections. Either innocent, or very well filed.
{title}. Nobody mentions it. Somebody made sure of that.
mess: I'll pretend that was a theory.
Interesting arrangement. Heuss will hate it.
You've moved half the wall. I hope you know where it all goes.
reset: Back where I left them. You're welcome.
Wall restored. Your theory has been filed under 'no'.
leave: Back to the drawers. Leave the string where it is.
Closing the link room. Try not to think about it.
